groups.position_defense: How much the opponent allows to the player's position (guards, forwards, centers), not just overall
groups.size: Player height and weight, and the height gap to the opponent's tallest and average available players
groups.opposing_defenders: Strength of the opponent's available defenders: best shot-blocker and ball thieves, accounting for injuries
groups.blowout_risk: Expected size of the win or loss: starters sit late in blowouts
groups.fatigue_travel: Games in the last 4 and 7 days, time zones crossed, road-trip length, altitude (Denver, Utah), recent minutes load
groups.injury_return: Games missed right before this one: players coming back are often on a minutes limit
groups.vs_opponent_history: How the player has done against this opponent before, compared with his usual level
groups.motivation: Team and opponent record, games left, playoffs: tanking teams and rested stars late in the season
groups.shooting_luck: Recent shooting compared with the player's normal: hot and cold streaks mostly even out
groups.age_experience: Age and years in the league: older players fade more on back-to-backs
